meta.title: Board Generator for CATAN — fair boards for the base game and Seafarers
meta.description: Free, unofficial app that deals fair, shareable boards for the CATAN base game and all nine Seafarers scenarios. Works offline, in five languages.
meta.ogDescription: Random boards for the base game and all nine Seafarers scenarios, balanced by the official rules and shareable with a code.

hero.title: A fair new island for every game
hero.lead: Random boards for the Catan base game and all nine Seafarers scenarios — balanced by the official rules, shareable with a code, and easy to read on your phone at the table.
hero.alt: The app showing a base-game board, its code and the legend

need.title: You’ll need the board game
need.text: This app only lays out the board. To play, you need your own copy of the CATAN base game; Seafarers scenarios also need the Seafarers expansion.

features.title: Built for the table, not the screen
features.lead: Setting up Catan should take a minute, not a debate about whose corner is too good.

items.title: Fair by the rules
items.text: 6 and 8 never touch, equal numbers stay apart and terrain is spread out, so no one starts on an unbeatable spot.

items.title: Base game & Seafarers
items.text: Every Seafarers scenario with its own islands, fog, gold fields and player counts, not just the classic island.

items.title: Share with a code
items.text: Each board gets a short code like anchor-4821. Send it and the whole table sees the same island.

items.title: Readable at arm’s length
items.text: Big tiles, clear numbers and probability dots, so you can set up straight from the phone.

items.title: What to take from the box
items.text: Terrain, token and harbor counts for every scenario, and where to look in the rulebook.

items.title: Works offline
items.text: Install it from the browser. It opens instantly at the table, even without signal.

gallery.title: Every screen, made for the table

items.title: Set up in seconds
items.text: Game, scenario, player count and token rules on one screen.

items.title: Know what to unpack

items.title: Share with one code

steps.title: Lay it out & share
steps.text: Copy the board onto the table and send the code so everyone can check it.

deal.title: Dealt the way you’d deal it
deal.lead: Coast first, then tiles in a spiral from the centre, then tokens and harbors. Under a second, and you can see exactly what changed.

math.title: Why 6 and 8 never touch
math.text: Five of the 36 dice combinations roll a 6, and five more roll an 8. Put them side by side and a single crossing pays out on 10 rolls in 36. The generator keeps them apart, and also keeps equal numbers and identical terrain from clumping.

faq.title: Good to know
faq.lead: Still unsure? Open the app — it’s free and takes no setup.

items.a: Yes. No accounts, no ads and nothing to buy.

items.q: Do I still need the board game?
items.a: Yes. The app only lays out the board: you play with your own copy of CATAN, plus the Seafarers expansion for its scenarios and the 5–6 player extension for the bigger island.

items.q: Is this an official CATAN app?
items.a: No. It’s a free, unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by CATAN GmbH or its publishers.

items.q: Can my friends see the same board?
items.a: Yes. Every board has a code: send the link or just the code, and everyone sees the same island on any device and in any language.

Tile, token and harbor counts and the victory targets come from the base game and Seafarers rulebooks. 6 and 8 stay apart as the Seafarers rules ask; keeping equal numbers apart and spreading terrain are house rules you can switch off.

host.title: Run your own copy
host.lead: The app is open source under the MIT License: a static site with no backend. Run it on your own server or computer; every copy deals the same board from the same code.
host.dockerText: One command starts the published image, for amd64 and arm64.
host.dockerNote: Then open localhost:8080. To install it on phones and use it offline, serve it over HTTPS, for example behind your reverse proxy.
host.localText: With Node.js 22 or later and npm: clone the repository, install, start.
host.more: Docker Compose, Vercel and updates: see the README
